answers.rationale: RCC has the largest transcript share (0.976). Purity-adjusted lfc 7.787 - 1.96*0.579 = 6.65 > 0, so the interval is above 0.
CD8_T has a transcript share of 0.737, larger than RCC at 0.072. A non-RCC group exceeds RCC, so the answer is no.
RCC has the largest share (0.881). Purity lfc 4.88 - 1.96*0.598 = 3.71 > 0. The ENTITY_37 purity record was ignored as it belongs to another entity.
For ENTITY_55, Macrophage share (0.574) exceeds RCC (0.233), so a non-RCC group is larger. The Endothelial record belongs to ENTITY_59 and was not used.
